scope: Phase 7b — multi-source view (Cargo, NPM, releases) in the Calix GPUI frontend

steps.name: state-reader
steps.detail: backend/calix_state.rs reads $XDG_STATE_HOME/calix/{cargo,npm,releases}.json, fault-tolerant on missing or malformed files

steps.name: merge
steps.detail: calix_state::merge_installed() is the single merge point used by the initial load and the reload path

steps.name: source-kinds
steps.detail: PackageSourceKind::Cargo/Npm/Release so an ecosystem package is never keyed as ALPM

steps.name: semantics
steps.detail: ecosystem packages expose no install/remove action and no dependency resolution; they are not ALPM

steps.name: presentation
steps.detail: source-cargo.svg, source-npm.svg, source-release.svg + badge colours + dedicated inspector panels

steps.name: live
steps.detail: Installed view shows 1906 packages; cargo/release/npm inspectors render their own metadata

defects_found_during_live_verification: The ecosystem merge was applied only to the reload path; the initial load still returned 1876 packages. Fixed by extracting merge_installed() and using it in both call sites, with a unit test.

PackageKey::from_unified mapped unknown source types to ALPM, so a cargo crate fetched the ALPM details of a same-named AUR package (wrong upstream URL, 'INSTALL REASON: Not Installed'). Fixed with dedicated source kinds, with a unit test.
known_gaps: The Calix ecosystems are listed, not searchable: the search backends remain ALPM/AUR/Flatpak/AppImage only.
The ecosystem packages have no install or remove action, because no backend path manages them yet.
AppImages are still served by the Shelly CLI backend; only Cargo, NPM and releases are read from the Calix inventory.
